thread:
tara: Noticed a p95 tail in eu-west dedicated pool at 06:10 UTC. Correlates with SNAT port pressure + conntrack growth.
mike: same. small requests (50-200 tokens) jump from 30ms->500ms. NAT gw shows many ephemeral ports tied up.
henry: infra-bot: ALERT snat-pressure eu-west-nat-1 97% ports_in_use. Likely ephemeral port exhaustion from many short TCP connects.
infra-bot: ACTION_CREATED change #5122 - temporary route heavy tenants -> nat-2-eu-west.
claire: Quick triage: offending flows are to internal kv cluster (kv-eu-3) with many clients opening TLS per call. No keepalive/h2.
tara: Short-term: flip routing to nat-2 (low cost) + enable envoy new_conn limiter on canary nodes. Long-term: per-tenant outbound proxy or SDK keepalive defaults.
mike: I can flip routing for top-5 offenders for 30m. Add guardrail: revert if nat-2 >95% for >5m.
henry: Also enable per-tenant telemetry: new_conn_rate and snat_ports_per_tenant. Set alert at 1.5k new_conn/s or 85% SNAT.
infra-bot: CHANGE_APPLIED: routing change in progress. Monitoring SNAT usage.
oncall: oncall here, applying envoy limiter to eu-west-canary. Rule: token-bucket 1500 new_conn/s per tenant, burst 3k. Rollout to 10% nodes first.
claire: If limiter causes client errors we should surface a graceful 429 with retry-after so SDKs can backoff. Add to sidecar filter.
mike: After routing change SNAT fell to 44% on nat-1; latency p95 back to ~45ms. Envoy limiter on canary looks ok.
tara: Follow-ups: 1) telemetry PR for per-tenant new_conn and per-nat-gw ephemeral_ports 2) small runbook "egress-port-saturation" 3) cost calc: extra nat gw vs per-tenant proxy infra + ops 4) SDK guidance for keepalive and HTTP/2 multiplexing.
henry: Long-term: evaluate internal VPC endpoints for kv to bypass SNAT for heavy internal traffic. Needs security review. Also prototype node-level multiplexer to collapse outbound 4-tuples.
infra-bot: RESOLVED if metrics stable for 30m. Auto-escalate at 95% SNAT for >5m.
claire: I'll own the SDK outreach note and template for SEs. mike will draft cost comparison. tara will write the runbook stub.
mike: Will do. Posting postmortem stub in #postmortems when stable.
